title: ee.focus.suggest.v1
description: Read-only recommendation surface for ee focus suggest. Topics are ranked by centrality_sum + recency_weight + span_density over the recent-evidence window. With --from-cass and no explicit task frame, positively admitted, public, unlinked CASS excerpts can seed recommendations even when the workspace has no memories. Transcript-only clusters retain their native EvidenceIds and have zero memory-graph centrality; they never create synthetic memories. Explicit task frames retain their memory-link scope. Missing source storage is reported separately from an empty eligible recency window.

recommendations.description: Ranked memory-backed or independent transcript-backed recommendations. Independent transcript topics require fromCass and no taskFrame scope; their complete excerpts pass source admission and public-output screening before a topic preview is derived.

topic.description: Short source-derived topic label summarizing what the agent should focus on next.

spanIds.description: Native ee EvidenceIds for admitted CASS excerpts supporting this cluster, never upstream CASS identifiers or invented MemoryIds. May represent evidence attached to memory members or independent unlinked excerpts. Populated only when fromCass is true; entries are deduplicated and sorted lexically.

centralityScore.description: Memory-graph centrality contribution only, not the composite ranking score. Independent transcript-only topics have zero centrality even though recency and span density can rank them highly.

rationale.description: Why this topic surfaced. Reports actual memory-member and CASS-span counts, graph centrality, and most recent evidence time.

suggestedQuery.description: Concrete shell-escaped ee pack command using source-derived topic words. No command is executed by this read-only recommendation.

fromCass.description: Echoes the request to include admitted CASS evidence. It does not imply every returned cluster has a transcript contribution; inspect spanIds and rationale.

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations the response may return. Mirrors --limit (default 5).

recentHours.description: Look-back window over stored source creation times. Mirrors --recent-hours (default 24); it does not claim the upstream session itself occurred in that window.

recommendations.rationale: Centrality 0.0000 aggregated over 0 memory(ies); 2 CASS span(s); most recent evidence at 2026-09-27T12:00:00+00:00.
recommendations.suggestedQuery: ee pack "Release validation needs a review" --workspace . --max-tokens 4000 --json
